commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate C# models and serializers from Avro schema files.

options.name: --schema
options.description: Path to an .avsc file or a directory of .avsc files.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to write generated C# files to.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: C# namespace for all generated types (overrides Avro namespaces).

options.name: --namespace-map
options.description: Map an Avro namespace to a C# namespace: avro.ns=CSharp.Ns (repeatable).

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate Avro schema files without generating code.

arguments.name: SCHEMA
arguments.description: Path to an .avsc file or a directory of .avsc files.
